name: JTBD2 — Extract-refresh task + schedule inventory
description: Job-performance JTBD inventory path. Requires ADMIN_TOOLS_ENABLED=true and site-admin PAT on Tableau Cloud. Model should use list-extract-refresh-tasks to enumerate every extract-refresh task and its schedule (cadence such as Hourly vs Daily), which explains which task dominates total execution load. Read-only.
prompt: Inventory all extract-refresh tasks on this site along with their schedules (cadence). Use the list-extract-refresh-tasks tool. Report each task, its target datasource, and its schedule frequency, and note which task runs most often. Do not modify anything.
